contractAuthority.scope: All public APIs and cross-boundary contracts
contractAuthority.enforcement: Contracts are single source of truth - no alternative implementations allowed

stateAuthority.enforcement: All database operations must go through DatabaseCore interfaces

typeAuthority.scope: ECS primitives (World, EntityId, Component, System), Sendable types
typeAuthority.enforcement: Core types cannot be redefined or shadowed in capability modules

governanceAuthority.scope: CLI surface, security events, trust state, automation output
governanceAuthority.enforcement: Only CLI wrapper scripts may invoke Harmonia binaries directly

provenanceAuthority.scope: Artifact containerization, hash computation, ledger structure
provenanceAuthority.enforcement: All evidence and receipt generation must use Accessum contracts
